item.title: KJ Atwood Decides to Run for South Carolina House District 110
item.description: KJ Atwood announced today that he is dropping out of the South Carolina 1st Congressional District primary race and will instead run for the South Carolina House of Representatives in District 110.

item.title: Charleston’s Hamby Catering Shares 2026 Easter Menu and ‘Hamby Hacks’ for Stress-Free Hosting
item.description: Hamby Catering & Events announced the return of its Easter menu, including various offerings and serving packages for the 2026 season.

item.title: Society of Bluffton Artists Celebrates Grand Reopening and Ribbon Cutting on April 11
item.description: The Society of Bluffton Artists (SOBA) invites the community to celebrate its Grand Reopening and Ribbon Cutting Event with a full day of art, student exhibitions, and family-friendly activities in the heart of Bluffton.

item.title: What Brands Consider When Developing Fresh Refrigerated Dips
item.description: Making a dip at home is easy. Throw some stuff in a blender, taste it, adjust it, and it's done. Making one that sits in a grocery store cooler for three weeks and still tastes good? That's a completely different game. The flavor can't fade. The texture can't separate. Nothing can spoil. And somehow, all of that has to happen without a chemistry set's worth of artificial ingredients. It's a process that requires far more consideration than most people realize.

item.title: Project 3500 Design Charrette Opens March 16, Public Invited to Kickoff, Open House, and Work in Progress Presentation
item.description: The City of Charleston, in partnership with the Charleston Housing Authority, the WestEdge Foundation, and Charleston County, will host a weeklong design charrette focused on mixed-income, mixed-use affordable and workforce housing opportunities

item.title: Annie's Hot Donuts to Close After 8 Years; Final Day Is March 22
item.description: After more than eight years in business, Annie's Hot Donuts announced on social media that it will close, with its final day of service set for Sunday, March 22.

item.description: Charleston County Parks’ live music series on the Mount Pleasant Pier, Dancing on the Cooper, is back on select Friday evenings

item.title: City of Charleston Celebrates Completion of Bridgepoint Ecological Park and Playground
item.description: The City of Charleston today celebrated the completion of Bridgepoint Ecological Park and Playground with a ribbon-cutting ceremony in the Shadowmoss neighborhood of West Ashley.
